lines.en: The next morning, Niki called off her photo-shoot.
The reason she gave to her manager and producers was, of course, something along the lines of just “not feeling well” since a breakup would likely be in violation of her contract.
So it’s rescheduled to next weekend instead now. And it’ll be the last calendar shoot she does before making an announcement that her career is coming to an end.
“Graduating” I think they call it in the idol world. So hey, at least someone gets to since it’s not like any of the other girls I know will be doing that any time soon.
Ami and Noriko don’t know yet. In fact, I don’t think Noriko’s exchanged a single word with her sister since she walked in on us last night.
Which is probably why the ride back to town is so awkward. And why I’d probably jump out of this moving car right now if it weren’t for the fact that it would further traumatize Ami.
At least she’s in a good mood.

Though, I can’t imagine she will be for long as I fully intend to ruin that by pulling her aside once we’re home and asking her why she’d orchestrate such a dramatic takedown of a girl I thought she loved.
I imagine she’ll tell me it was for my sake. Or that she wasn’t trying to search for us last night — she just couldn’t come up with an excuse to stop Niki from doing it.
Whatever the case, I’m mad at her in addition to myself for playing some sort of role in this.
And, you know what? Fuck it. I’m mad at Niki too because she won’t even look at me today. Which is entirely fair and I wouldn’t look at me either, but I’m still mad.
She could at least have the courtesy to tell me to fuck off or something. But instead, the only one here I’m not mad at is Noriko because she didn’t do anything wrong.
I just also feel terrible for dragging her into this mess. But I’m sure if you asked her, she wouldn’t tell you she regrets it. Just that she regrets getting caught.
So...like me. Just not nearly as bad for obvious reasons.
: So! How about we play a game to make this ride a little less quiet and a lot more fun? Anyone up for Shiritori? I’ll go first! Maguro!
: Ami-
: Bzzzzzt! You needed to come up with a word that started with “ro,” Dad! Now, you’ve already been eliminated and it’s just us girls left.
: No, Ami. I just don’t think anyone wants to play Shiri-
: Romaji.
: Jitensha!
: Okay. Fuck me, I guess.
: Again? But you guys went at it for so long last night.
: Oh, cool. Ami broke the pattern so I win.
: Ah, crap.
: Way to go, Dad. She beats me in love. She beats me in boobs. And now she beats me in Shiritori. I have literally nothing left.
: We can play again if you want. Beats sitting in awkward silence.
: Mame.
: Megami.
: Minato.
: Tomato.
: Toma-
: Crap!
: I think you just suck at this game, Ami. Want to play something else instead?
: Sure! What do you have in mind?
: Hmm...let’s see...let’s see...
: Oh! I brought Karuta! Nii-chan, can you slide over? I need to get my bag.
: Karuta? I haven’t played that in forever. I’m not even sure I remember how.
: Nee-chan taught me, so I will pass down the mystic art to you! Onii-chan, do you want to-
: But you two have fun...
After what can only be described as the longest drive of my life, we make it back to the house and Niki-
: I’m taking the bed. Don’t come in.
...Avoids me, as expected.
That’s fine, though. I can sleep on the couch instead. And besides, it’s not like I got even a minute of sleep last night, so anywhere is fine right now.
I’ll just...leave her alone.
I can do that, right?
: Yikes...
: Yeah. Turns out girls don’t like it very much when you have sex with their sister instead of them.
: I mean, I also don’t like that you had sex with Noriko. But you don’t see me avoiding you because of it. Maybe Aunt Niki’s just in a bad mood today?
: Shut up, Ami. Just...please shut up.
: Wow. Maybe you’re in a bad mood too, Dad.
: Hahah...hah...I, uhh...
: I should probably go. I imagine you guys, uhh...want some space today.
: But, uhh...call me? Is it...weird for me to say that now? I am in a...rather unique and new situation all of a sudden.
: Later, Noriko. Thanks for fucking my dad and teaching me how to play Karuta.
: Chk, chk! Any time, sis!
: Okay. Tone it down, please.
: I am so sorry you had to see that.
: It’s okay! Bye, Noriko!
: Bye, Ami! Bye, Nii-chan! Thanks for...all the sex!
: GYAAAAAAAH! WHAT AM I DOING?! BE NORMAL, NORIKO! JUST BE NORMAL!
: Hahah! Oh, Noriko. Look at how happy she is now that she’s finally gotten what she-
: Ami. A word, please? In private.
: But we’re already in private, Dad. This is our house. It’s the only the place in the world where the two of us can-
: In your room. Now.
: My room? But-
: Ami...now.
: Jeez, Dad. All you had to do was say “please.” You know I can’t say no to you when you do that.
: Not like I’d ever want to anyway, though. You always know what’s best for me after all! And I mean, of course that’s the case given how long we-
: Did you help Niki come find us last night?
: Hm? Yeah.
: Ami-
: But she’s the one who figured out you were there. And I can imagine you saw it coming since I’m clearly not the type to engage in lesbian sex with anyone.
: It was a terrible lie. But I saw it through to the end for your sake, Dad. I could only hold her off for so long.
: But you helped her...You knew I was alone with Noriko, and you helped Niki find us.
: ...Right. But how was I supposed to know you two were having sex? Wasn’t that the first time?
: Ami-
: Sorry, why am I somehow in trouble for you having sex with your girlfriend’s little sister? Is this some kind of roleplay thing? Did you put your dad-pants on this morning?
: Why are you not upset?...You see how much she’s hurting, don’t you? Do you have any idea what this means for me and her? Don’t you like her?
: Of course I like her, Dad! Aunt Niki’s done so much for both of us. I love her with all of my heart.
: But at the same time, don’t you guys think you might be overreacting a little bit? Like, is it really so bad that she just saw you being yourself? She was gonna find out eventually.
: Yes, eventually. Organically. Not at the behest of my jealous daughter and her need to always be involved in every facet of my life.
: You seem quite mad at me, Father. Perhaps a blowjob is in order?
: No, Ami. I don’t want a fucking blowjob. I want you to stay out of my private affairs and-
: You seem quite mad at me, Father. Come closer. I will hug you until you’re feeling better.
: I don’t want a fucking hug, Ami. I want you to stay out of my private affairs and-
: And what? Let you torpedo your life all on your own? Got it. It’s not my fault you fucked Noriko and broke Niki’s heart. Don’t blame me for that.
: You helped her! And I don’t know what you two were talking about before you found us, but something tells me it wasn’t exactly wholesome.
: It was very wholesome, actually. Aunt Niki and I had a really long heart-to-heart in the bath about how much we love you and how we’re both so desperate to make you happy.
: I even got to talk about my mom.
: And for a second, it almost felt like she was there with us, giving Niki her blessing while patting me on the head and thanking me for taking such good care of you.
: Which...makes it so much sadder that Aunt Niki’s going to move out now. I was just starting to really like having her around too. This trip was a turning point for us I think. And now that she’s-
: Niki isn’t moving out.
: What?
: What do you mean she isn’t moving out?
: I mean she’s going to stay here. We’re just...not going to be spending much time together.
: Then...why is she staying here?
: Convenience? Maybe for you?
: For me.
: Maybe. She didn’t give me a reason. I thought she was moving out too. But she told me she was going to stay.
: You fuck her little sister right in front of her...for five hours...
: And she’s still going to live with us?
: That’s right...she’s not leaving just yet.
: Is she a fucking idiot?
: Ami...that’s-
: You FUCK her little sister...
: For FIVE fucking hours...
: And you’re telling me that she’s just going to stay.
: Is there a problem with that, Ami?
: Oh, no! Not at all, Dad!
: In fact, I think it’s great living under the same roof as someone so open-minded! It makes me so extremely curious about which one of my classmates you’re going to fuck in front of her next!
: Boy, I sure do hope it’s me!
: So that’s why you were smiling all morning...You thought she was leaving.
: Oh, forgive me for wanting my life back! You’re the one who invited her here! Not me!
: You were smiling when you interrupted Maya and me the other night as well.
: Mhm! I did offer to watch, though. So it’s not like I’m evil, is it?
: Is it?...
I look down at her, but I do not see my daughter.
I see someone who looks like her...talks like her...smells like her...but my daughter wishes for nothing but my happiness.
And this girl wants to hurt me.
: You have no idea how much I do for you...do you, Dad?
: You’ve always done everything for me, Ami...but that doesn’t give you the right to toy with the people I love and-
: Oh, no. No, no, no. I’m not talking about cooking...or cleaning...or filing your fucking taxes. I am talking about everything else. The things I do that you don’t see.
: Well, then how the fuck would I know about them, Ami?
: YOU WOULDN’T! THAT’S THE FUCKING POINT!
: So when I ask you if you have any idea how much I do for you, the answer is obviously no! “No, Ami! I don’t know what you do! But thank you! I love you! Yours truly, Father!”
: Fine! Sure! But either way, the fact that you’re running around and praying for the downfall of the people I love-
: Don’t fucking talk to me about praying, Dad! Not even as a figure of speech! I will not lose you to some fucking worthless God as well!
: What the fuck is that supposed to mean?! Who else have you lost to-
: YOU KNOW EXACTLY WHO I LOST!
: YOU SAW WHAT WAS HAPPENING TO HER AND YOU IGNORED IT! YOU WERE THE ONLY ONE SHE TRUSTED AND YOU DIDN’T FUCKING LISTEN! YOU LET IT CONSUME HER!
: POEM AFTER POEM AFTER POEM! VOICES, VOICES, VOICES! IT’S NO WONDER SHE COULDN’T BREATHE WITH A NOOSE LIKE THAT AROUND HER NECK!!
: Your mom...died in an accident, Ami...
: She didn’t-
: I know how she fucking died! But she was practically dead for a whole fucking year before that while her mind was being overrun by who the fuck knows what!
: And you could have done something! You could have listened! Because I know you read the poems! But you didn’t understand them! You didn’t believe them! No one did!
: And I...how am I supposed to think you’ll believe me then?
: I don’t blame you for the fact that she’s gone. I just...when I think about how scared she must have been that last year...I can’t take it...
: I can’t take it...
: AAAAAAAAHHHHH! I CAN’T TAKE IT! IT HURTS TOO MUCH!
: AND NOW YOU HATE ME TOO?! I HAVE NO HAIR LEFT TO CUT OFF! I WAS ONLY DOING WHAT I HAD TO!
: So what?...You had to get Niki out of the house?
: Will that bring your mom back, Ami? Is that what you want?
: Don’t fucking talk to me like that...
: I will NOT let you TALK to me like THAT! Not with everything I have to endure for YOUR SAKE!
: Ami...
: What happened to you?...
: What HAPPENED to me?!
: YOU DID! YOU happened to me! I’m like this because of YOU!
: And you fucking KNOW it because it’s the only GOD DAMN FUCKING REASON you will let me call you “Dad” now!
: Do you have ANY idea how fucking HARD it is for a seven year old to raise TWO PEOPLE when you’re in your fucking THIRTIES and can’t even raise YOURSELF?!
: But now I’M the bad guy because you lost something you never deserved and need someone to BLAME?! I DID NOTHING!
: You wanted her gone...
: YOU’RE DAMN FUCKING RIGHT I DID!
: BECAUSE DESPITE ALL OF THAT! DESPITE THE PAIN AND TORTURE AND NEVER KNOWING IF YOU WILL EVER TRULY UNDERSTAND THE SHEER GRAVITY OF WHAT I DO FOR YOU...
: DESPITE KNOWING THAT THE LAST YEAR OF MY MOM’S LIFE IS THE ONE THING YOU’LL NEVER STOP SUPPRESSING...
: Despite all of that...
: I have never stopped living for you.
: The one thing I have left.
: But sometimes?...
: I feel like you’d be happier if I died too.
: And there’s only one way to find out if that’s true or not.
: Ami-
: Don’t follow me.
: I want to be alone.
: Can you at least tell me where you’re going?
: Somewhere I won’t be a fucking burden anymore!
: Ami-
I kept thinking to myself — as I stood there in a room a little girl decorated without my help — that there was no way Niki could hear all of this and not come in to tell me things will be okay.
But she didn’t.
So I stood there for the next half hour, wondering how to make love stay. But there was nothing I came up with that didn’t immediately make things worse.
Now she’s gone. And Ami’s gone. And not even the ghost is here to poke fun at how badly I’ve fucked everything up this time.
And sure, there are places for me to go...
Other people who’d be happy to help me right now...
But I’m too scared to call them.
I just miss my daughter.
I miss my childhood friend.
And I’ve only been alone for thirty minutes.
I lie down in Ami’s bed. And when I close my eyes, I can almost trick myself into believing she’s still here.
But despite having stayed awake all night, I’m unable to fall asleep. I feel like I don’t deserve this bed.
Or her.
Or any of this.
But there is a closet-
Propped open by a school bag with a notebook sticking out.
And for some reason-
I think I’ll be able to sleep in there.
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
Everyone else has abandoned you...
